dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: 初めまして相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いします。まず初めに年齢と性別を教えて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you, I'm the counselor. Thank you for being here today. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 28才　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm 28 years old, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのような相談内容になりますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 教師をしているんですが、自信をなくしています
dialogue.English: I'm a teacher, but I've been losing my confidence.

dialogue.content: 教師をされているんですね。教師はやることが多くて大変ですよね。小学校でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, you’re a teacher. There’s so much to juggle; it can be very demanding. Is it an elementary school?

dialogue.content: はい、小４を受け持っています
dialogue.English: Yes, I teach fourth grade.

dialogue.content: 小４なんですね。自信をなくしているとのことですが、どんな感じで自信をなくしてしまった感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Fourth grade, I see. You mentioned you're losing your confidence. Could you tell me more about how you've come to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 最近、授業中にも落ち着きのない子が多かったり、
dialogue.English: Recently, there have been a lot of restless children during class, and...

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 学校を休みがちな子が増えてきたりでクラスにまとまりがないような感じなんです。
dialogue.English: ...the number of children who are frequently absent has been increasing, so it feels like the class lacks cohesion.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。。まとまりがないと教師の負担は増えてしまいますもんね。。
dialogue.English: I understand. When the class lacks cohesion, the burden on the teacher really increases, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: クラスに児童数はどのくらいいる感じですか？
dialogue.English: About how many students are in your class?

dialogue.content: 33人です
dialogue.English: There are 33.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。33人をまとめるというのは大変ですよね。児童が休みがちとあるのは何か要因とかありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Managing 33 students must be very challenging. Is there any particular reason why the students are frequently absent?

dialogue.content: きっとコロナのことも影響してるとは思うのですが、授業中に寝てしまう子もいて、なんだかみんな疲れているみたいに感じます
dialogue.English: I think COVID-related issues are affecting things, and some children even fall asleep during class. It feels like everyone is just tired.

dialogue.content: 小学生で寝てるというのは余程疲れているんですかね。そういう児童に対してはどのようにアプローチして行っている状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: For an elementary school student to be sleeping in class, they must be quite exhausted. How are you currently approaching those students?

dialogue.content: 声はかけているのですが、最近では何も話してくれない子もいます
dialogue.English: I do reach out to them, but lately some of them won’t say anything at all.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは不安に感じてしまいますよね。。。他の学級はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see, that must make you feel anxious. What are the other classes like?

dialogue.content: 学年は人クラスなんです
dialogue.English: There's only one class per grade.

dialogue.content: 一クラス、です
dialogue.English: I mean, just one class.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。唯一の4年生だったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see—so yours is the only fourth-grade class.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先生大変ですよね。。いつ頃から自信を失いかけている状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: That must be so difficult for you. When did you start to feel like you were losing your confidence?

dialogue.content: 5月頃から、徐々に様子が変わってきてる気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like things have been gradually changing since around May.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね、半年間ですよね。。耐えられてきたんですね。。
dialogue.English: I see, so for about half a year... You've been enduring it for that long.

dialogue.content: そんな感じなので、成績にも出てしまって
dialogue.English: Because of that, it's starting to show in their grades.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 職員会議でも問題になってるんです
dialogue.English: It’s become an issue in staff meetings as well.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。。それは辛いですよね。そうなると職員会議ではどんな感じで言われますか？
dialogue.English: I understand... that must be painful. In the staff meetings, what kinds of things are being said?

dialogue.content: "教師が悪い、"親が悪い、とか、言い合いになることもあって、つらいです
dialogue.English: Sometimes it turns into an argument, with people saying, "It's the teacher's fault," or "It's the parents' fault." It's hard.

dialogue.content: なるほど、現場を理解してもらえてない感じなですね。管理職の先生はどんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see—it sounds like the situation on the ground isn’t being fully understood. How are the administrators responding?

dialogue.content: クラスを見に来てくれましたけど、その時、一時的な対応に過ぎなかったので、特段変わりはないんです
dialogue.English: They came to observe the class, but it was just a temporary response, so nothing has really changed.

dialogue.content: 非協力的な感じなんですね。そうなると相談者様の負担がより増す感じですよね。。。耐えられてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: So they seem uncooperative. That must add even more to your burden... You've really been enduring it.

dialogue.content: その時はまあ、ありがたいとは思いましたが、変わりがないのはどうしていいかわかりません
dialogue.English: At the time, I did appreciate it, but since nothing has changed, I’m not sure what to do.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。。。状況変えるのがコロナということもあり、難しい状況ですよね。。。
dialogue.English: I understand... With COVID-19 also being a factor, it's a difficult situation to change.

dialogue.content: はい、保護者からも問い合わせがあったりして、いたたまれません
dialogue.English: Yes, and I've also been getting inquiries from parents, which makes me feel so uncomfortable.

dialogue.content: うんうん。そうですよね。保護者は休みがちな児童の保護者ですか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. I can imagine. Are these the parents of the children who are often absent?

dialogue.content: いえ、成績に敏感な親御さんからですね
dialogue.English: No, it’s from parents who are very sensitive about grades.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。。。どんな感じで問い合わせてくる感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see... What kinds of questions or concerns do they raise?

dialogue.content: 授業中の様子の異変のことと、それに、やっぱり成績は目に見えたりするので、心配されてくる感じですね
dialogue.English: They ask about unusual behaviors during class, and since grades are visible, they express concerns about those too.

dialogue.content: 親御さんも心配になられるところですが、クラスのことや成績のことは、簡単な話じゃないですもんね。。
dialogue.English: It's understandable that parents would be concerned, but matters of the class and academic performance aren't simple issues, are they?

dialogue.content: 問い合わせに対してはどのような対応をされている感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How have you been responding to those inquiries?

dialogue.content: コロナ休校で授業が遅れた分は、全力で挽回しております"って、対応しています
dialogue.English: I've been telling them, "We are doing our utmost to make up for the class time lost to the COVID school closures."

dialogue.content: 寝てしまっている子の親御さんからは心配の連絡は来ないのですから、
dialogue.English: The parents of the children who fall asleep in class haven't contacted me with any concerns, so...

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 私も困ってしまいます
dialogue.English: ...I'm at a loss too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。困りますよね。。一旦話を整理しますね。
dialogue.English: Right... that would be troubling... Let's take a moment to summarize what we've discussed.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 4年生唯一のクラスを受け持ち、コロナの影響からか、児童が疲れているのかまとまりがない。職員会議でも話は上がる。責任の所在の言い合いや、成績に敏感な保護者から問い合わせもあり、管理職は一時的には対応して頂いているが特段変化はない状況。
dialogue.English: You're in charge of the only fourth-grade class. Perhaps due to the effects of COVID, the students seem tired and the class lacks cohesion. The issue is being raised in staff meetings, leading to arguments about who is responsible. You're also receiving inquiries from parents who are sensitive about grades, and while administrators have provided temporary support, there has been no significant change.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: そうなんです、どうしたらいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That’s right. What should I do?

dialogue.content: 難しいですよね。先生としては頑張っていると思いますし、自信をなくす必要はないと思います。相談者様的には理想のゴールはどのような形になりますか？
dialogue.English: It is difficult. I believe you're doing your best as a teacher, and I don't think you need to lose confidence. From your perspective, what would be an ideal outcome?

dialogue.content: 前のように、子どもたちが元気を取り戻してほしいですね
dialogue.English: I'd like the children to get their energy back, like they used to.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。元気取り戻して欲しいですよね！
dialogue.English: I see. You want them to regain their energy, of course!

dialogue.content: はい話しかけてみても反応薄いんです
dialogue.English: Yes, even when I try talking to them, their responses are minimal.

dialogue.content: 反応が薄いと、本音が見えてこないですもんね。。。どんな感じで話かけているんですか？
dialogue.English: When their reactions are muted, it's hard to know what they're really feeling... How have you been trying to talk to them?

dialogue.content: 近づけないので、疲れてるの? "って、感じですね
dialogue.English: I can't get too close, so it's more like, "Are you tired?"

dialogue.content: 子どもの表情も暗いので、心配です
dialogue.English: The children's expressions are gloomy too, so I'm worried.

dialogue.content: 距離とって、長くは話しません
dialogue.English: I keep my distance and don’t talk for long.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。表情も暗いと心配になりますよね。話かけているのはマンツーマンとかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's worrying when their expressions are gloomy. Are you talking to them one-on-one?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そこでも暗いと本当に何があったかわからないですよね。。。
dialogue.English: I see. If they're gloomy even then, it's hard to know what's really going on.

dialogue.content: 私のことが嫌いなのかと思ってしまいます…
dialogue.English: I start to wonder if they dislike me...

dialogue.content: そう思うと辛くなりますよね。。。
dialogue.English: That must be a painful thought to have.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのか…
dialogue.English: I don’t know what to do...

dialogue.content: うんうん。児童の要望、本音を聞いてみたいですよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. You want to hear what the students really want, what they're truly feeling.

dialogue.content: 多分、寝不足が続いてるんだろーなとは思っても、心配になります
dialogue.English: I suspect they're probably sleep-deprived, but even so, I worry.

dialogue.content: うんうん。心配になりますよね。冬休みに入りましたし、年明けの児童の顔をみてというのもアリかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It is worrying. They're on winter break now, so perhaps waiting to see their faces in the new year could be an option.

dialogue.content: 心配なのは、夜更かしがクセになってしまうことが大きいです
dialogue.English: My big concern is that staying up late will become a habit for them.

dialogue.content: 休み明けが怖いです
dialogue.English: I'm scared of what it will be like after the break.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、そう思うと怖いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see, it's frightening when you think of it that way.

dialogue.content: 完全に学校に影響が出てしまいますもんね。時間をずらすこともできないし。
dialogue.English: It completely affects them at school, doesn't it? And you can't just change the school hours.

dialogue.content: なんだか、後手後手で、もっと早くにかなんとか手を打っておけば良かった。
dialogue.English: It feels like I'm always reacting too late; I wish I had done something sooner.

dialogue.content: （すみません、時間内に収束することができませんでした。ご迷惑をおかけしております。）
dialogue.English: (I apologize, we were not able to conclude within our allotted time. I am sorry for the inconvenience.)

dialogue.content: (いえ、勉強になりました。この後予定があるので、この辺にいたしましょう
dialogue.English: (No, this was very helpful. I have something scheduled after this, so let's end here.)

dialogue.content: あと1学期あるのでその手を打つというのもアリですよね。5年生に向けて。
dialogue.English: There's still one term left, so taking action then is also an option, in preparation for fifth grade.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 話せただけでもよかったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad I was just able to talk about it.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for your time today.

dialogue.content: それではシステム終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.English: I will now end the session.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
